partner_result.applied_inequality: int |phi_Q|^2 <= 6*pi*2^(2/3)|det D|^(-1/3), used for the low-frequency term in the general-q hybrid

new_results.summary: No uniform L2 restriction bound exists for the one-parameter translation/modulation line arising from the naive two-sided extension; explicit chirped cap-one probability amplitudes have ratio growing like 2L/3.
For every q>2, shifted quadratic phases of cap-one one-dimensional laws have an explicit uniform Lq_t norm C_sq(q)|d|^(-1/q).

The previous one-sided physical-square plus rank-two cross-bank Fourier theorem extends to every q>2, with explicit density bound and continuity. Optimizing q makes the small-pivot loss logarithmic relative to sqrt(Delta).

unresolved_implication: Prove a coupled product-preserving fractional-trace or full-packet Lq estimate for the genuinely two-sided square/rank-two packet, or give a source-valid exact-target L1 Fourier counterexample. L2 bank norms after rank-two Plancherel are insufficient by the new Gabor-line obstruction.
next_step: Retain original product-density information before the one-parameter time-frequency trace, rather than collapsing each bank to an L2 norm; test fractional trace estimates against the explicit chirped long-interval family.
